lg.draft: Draft for review. This text must be checked by a qualified legal adviser before launch.
lg.p1: Your account details (name, email, phone), family members you add, your bookings and prescriptions, and the reports and records you upload.
lg.p2: Documents are stored privately and are never given out as public links. Access is checked on our servers, and every view of a record or report is logged.
lg.p3: A record is shared with a doctor only when you choose, for 30 days, and you can stop it at any time. Doctors, labs and hospitals see only what they need for your booking.
lg.p4: You can edit your profile, remove records from your list, and contact support. How long data is kept, and how deletion works, will follow applicable law. [To be finalised]
lg.p5: Uploaded documents are kept in a storage location in Mumbai, India.
lg.p6: [Contact email and address to be added]
lg.t1: AAROGYA ORBIT helps you find doctors, labs and hospitals and manage bookings. It is not a medical provider and does not diagnose or prescribe.
lg.t2: In an emergency, call 112. Do not use this service for emergencies.
lg.t3: Doctors, labs and hospitals are independent. We check the registration documents they give us before listing them, but medical advice and care are their responsibility.
lg.t4: At present you pay at the clinic or lab. Online payment is not available yet. You can cancel from the app while the booking allows it.
lg.t5: Give correct information, and add a family member only if you are allowed to.
lg.t6: These terms may change. [Final text to be completed after legal review]
